title: Roadzen Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Roadzen Inc. (RDZN), a British Virgin Islands-incorporated insurance AI technology company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing participation in the Maxim Group 'Powering the AI Revolution' Virtual Conference on April 7, 2026. CEO Rohan Malhotra discussed the company's $60 million annualized revenue run rate, targets of $100 million run rate within 6-12 months, and anticipated adjusted EBITDA breakeven in the current quarter. The filing details the company's AI architecture, competitive positioning, and technology scale metrics.
key_points: Roadzen Inc. is an Emerging Growth Company filing an 8-K for participation in a virtual investor conference
CEO stated current annualized revenue run rate of approximately $60 million with target of $100 million within 6-12 months
Company anticipates reaching adjusted EBITDA breakeven in the current quarter (Q2 2026)
Company is a founding member of the AI Alliance (with Meta, IBM, Uber, ServiceNow) and develops specialized AI models for insurance underwriting and claims
Company reports processing approximately 3 million insurance claims annually and holds data on approximately 100 million historical claims
DrivebuddyAI platform demonstrated 72% reduction in accident rates in first year of deployment per fleet customer data
